text:
anya: Quick flag  periodic entitlement sweep shows ~290 admin=true principals across prod, ~52% ownerless. Some admin flags date back >200d.
sec-bot: automated upload: s3://redwood-sec/reports/entitlement-sweep-4332107777.csv :file_folder:
leo: Oof. Any immediate P1s?
anya: I marked 6 P1s: 2 SAs used by nightly exporters, 4 KMS keys with ambiguous grants and missing project tags.
tara: We should not remove any role before running a permission impact dry-run and CI smoke tests. Last rinse we had a stalled job.
anya: Agreed. Proposed cadence:
- Triage (48h): assign owners where obvious, create exceptions for infra-critical items.
- Dry-run (non-destructive): simulate removals and enumerate impacted resources/principals.
- Remediation window (next week): low-traffic hours with oncall and rollback script ready.
ops-oncall: emergency rollback script location: vault://scripts/fast_rebind.sh (ACL: sec-admins,sre-leads). Audit: vault://audits/rebind/4332107777.log
leo: Dry-run snippet?
anya: ``
./tools/perm_simulate --input s3://redwood-sec/reports/entitlement-sweep-4332107777.csv --simulate --out=sim_results.csv
``
leo: For KMS check: we should dump IAM bindings and scan for serviceAccount principals matching our SAs. Example gcloud command: ``gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PR/locations/global/keyRings/KR/cryptoKeys/KEY --format=json``
tara: Also suggest a staging honeypot: remove admin from a mirrored SA in staging and run smoke tests to validate detection and rollback.
anya: Action items:
- @leo: assemble smoke-test matrix for flagged SAs (due Wed)
- @tara: enumerate KMS keys missing project tags and owners (due Thu)
- @ops-oncall: validate emergency script perms and rotate vault token (due Mon)
- @anya: run triage and attach owner tags where possible (start now)
leo: I'll ping teams owning exporters and schedulers, propose a 48h notice before any removal.
tara: If we detect keys without tags, propose infra create a ticketing hook: detect -> create owner-ticket -> notify owner. Low friction.
ops-oncall: Confirmed emergency script requires 2FA and writes audit entry on each run. Recommend a canned rollback playbook added to the incident runbook.
anya: I'll create the board ticket and schedule a discovery-run. Keep updates short here.
leo: Update: exporters team acked, can test this Friday night.
tara: KMS enumeration done; posted CSV to ticket. 8 keys missing tags, 3 used by cron SAs (flagged HIGH).
ops-oncall: Emergency script perms reviewed; access limited to SRE leads + sec admins. I'll add quick run command to playbook.
anya: Thanks all. Will post Phase A summary in 18h. :thumbsup:
